notes.title: 🔧 Tutorial Update
notes.content: [h1][b]⚙️ New Tutorial[/b][/h1][h3][b]version deployed 0.6.5[/b][/h3][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][p]You guys complained a lot that our tutorial didn't teach you anything. We thought it would be easy to teach you all the mechanics just by playing the game, but we realize that's a lot to expect while driving at full speed through a gigantic rift! We have overhauled the current tutorial and added text boxes and flashy images to explain everything. We hope this does the job — if not, join our [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord server[/url] and let us know why. We love the feedback you're giving us, and we love implementing your ideas.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, and we've also updated some other things in the game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]major tutorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p]added progress menu to garage and tutorial menu[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]added keyboard navigation for ui tab navigation[/p][/*][*][p]added more new chunks to biome 1[/p][/*][*][p]added new ad banner colors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]increased juice gain slightly[/p][/*][*][p]removed scrap drops from ad sails[/p][/*][*][p]reduced scrap cost increase in the pitstop during a run[/p][/*][*][p]reduced cost of some parts in the pitstop during a run[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted some parts of the map to be more fair[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]fixed slower obstacle mod not working properly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Quality of life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]inventory now shows both cards (of equipped and selected part)[/p][/*][*][p]equipped parts in inventory are properly highlighted on selection[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]looting an empty part-box will now also show a card pop-up[/p][/*][*][p]improved pitstop UI layout[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]changed the color of default part icons in inventories to make them more distinguishable from other parts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Again: If you find any bugs, want to give feedback or have some nice Ideas to make the game even better, feel free to join us on [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord[/url] and let us know.[/p][p]Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Our First Ever Gameplay Video is Here!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Our First Ever Gameplay Video is Here![/b][/h2][p]We just recorded our very first gameplay video where we tested our own game as if we were playing it for the very first time. Along the way, we explain the core mechanics, talk about all the features, and show off what makes our roguelite racer unique.[/p][p]Just two days ago, we released a brand-new update - and this video includes a showcase of the fresh features it brings. We also jump into a few runs to really put the game (and ourselves) to the test![/p][p]We’re super excited to share more gameplay with you in the future. This is our first gameplay video ever, so… enjoy - and please don’t be too harsh on us!
[/p][previewyoutube="uwH_hyOl2uA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Best,
Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update | Patch 0.6.5
notes.content: [h1][b]⚙️ New version deployed 0.6.5[/b][/h1][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We've listened to your feedback and added some new quality-of-life improvements to our game. Highlights include an updated inventory and new skills and upgrades.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]skill upgrades are now communicated more clearly in Skill chunks, the pitstop, and the Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]added new Salt Lake chunks (Biome 1)[/p][/*][*][p]scrap costs are increased with each consecutive pitstop[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]cacti now give Juice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed an issue where parts could be equipped in the background when progressing in the reward menu after a run[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed screenshake stacking[/p][/*][*][p]fixed juice and scrap loot colliding with drive camera[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug where the tutorial reward mod would disappear[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]adjusted all scrap costs in the pitstop[/p][/*][*][p]reduced Juice gain overall[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]improved inventory UI to make equipped items more visible[/p][/*][*][p]added a Pause Menu pop-up for “Quit Game” or “Give Up Run” confirmation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]improved chunks (level-design)[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted background in main menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]⚠️ Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]closing give up or quit menu with controller will also close pause menu at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]vSync enabled can cause lags[/p][/*][*][p]some graphics settings override each other[/p][/*][*][p]open pause will reset invincibility timer[/p][/*][*][p]no proper widescreen support[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you have any feedback for us, please get in touch – for example, via [url="https://discord.gg/N953Erqchk"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]Gino & Linus[/p]

notes.title: 🔧 New graphics option + minor improvements for 0.6.4
notes.content: [h2][b]⚙️[/b]New patch for 0.6.4 deployed[/h2][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]added motion blur and speed line toggle to settings[/p][/*][*][p]fixed floating grass in tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug when choosing part for pit stop shop[/p][/*][*][p]fixed floating tires in one chunk[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update | Patch 0.6.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]⚙️ New version deployed 0.6.4[/b][/h1][p][i]⭐️ = community feedback[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the feedback that you have provided via Discord, Steam and other media. We're thrilled to see so many people enjoying the SCHROTT demo. Since we want the demo to be in the best possible state, we are releasing a new update right now![/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]added a reward mod and part for completing the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]added 4 new world-chunks (level-design)[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]added a graphics tab to options[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Mayor Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed vanishing parts after run complete and looting/reward logic[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed equipping first part in inventory after buying a part in pit stop with same input[/p][/*][*][p]fixed boulder vanishing sometimes when shooting in quick succession[/p][/*][*][p]fixed sudden mute on run finish[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Balancing[/b][/h2][list][*][p]driving close to non damageable obstacles does not give juice anymore[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted some level-design (world-chunks)[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]skills now have more balanced cooldowns[/p][/*][*][p]player exp progression is now curved instead of linear[/p][/*][*][p]boost now only costs juice once not per second anymore[/p][/*][*][p]rebalanced speed mods[/p][/*][*][p]moving obstacle press movement is now linear[/p][/*][*][p]pitstop part shop is now connected to internal drop chances[/p][/*][*][p]skill upgrades can now have cooldown reductions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Other Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]fixed rig randomly rotating in pitstop inventory view[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]disabled cam shake in pause screen[/p][/*][*][p]fixed speed mod reset after equipping a part in pitstop[/p][/*][*][p]fixed equip part sound to only fire when parts are actually equipped or bought[/p][/*][*][p]disabled mods while in tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some world-chunks (level-design)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Misc[/b][/h2][list][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]adjusted pit stop UI for widescreen (still not fully supported)[/p][/*][*][p]added 60-FPS fallback to save and load[/p][/*][*][p][i]⭐️ [/i]adjusted options toggle selections[/p][/*][*][p]improved result screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]⚠️ Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]skill upgrades are not communicated properly[/p][/*][*][p]vSync enabled can cause lags[/p][/*][*][p]some graphics settings override each other[/p][/*][*][p]open pause menu will reset invincibility timer[/p][/*][*][p]no settings to disable motion blur or depth of field[/p][/*][/list][p]
That's all for now! Next, we will address the known issues and continue working on content for the full release.[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ SCHROTT @ Games Ground Berlin
notes.content:
[h2]⚙️ Meet us November 14th – 16th at Games Ground Berlin ⚙️[/h2]

Hello SCHROTT community! We’re excited to share some big news: SCHROTT will be featured at Games Ground Berlin, and we’d love for you to come by and say hi! 🎉

📅 Event Details
When? November 14th – 16th
Where? Alte Münze, Berlin Germany

🔗 [url=https://www.gamesground.de/]More about Games Ground Berlin[/url]

Here’s what to expect:

[list]
[*] New Content and Merch: We’ll be showing off some fresh content and you will be able to get cool stickers!
[*] Meet the Devs: Connect with our development team, and dive into the world of SCHROTT with us!
[*] Feedback and Discussion: We value your feedback, and we’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas to keep making SCHROTT better.
[/list]

If you’re in Berlin or nearby, don’t miss out! We’d love to meet you and work together on shaping the future of SCHROTT.

Looking forward to seeing you in Berlin! 💥

notes.title: ⚙️ Our First Devlog
notes.content:
[h2]⚙️ Let’s Talk About Money, Followers, Features, and the Team ⚙️[/h2]
We want to be as transparent as possible! So, let’s talk about everything. In this video, Linus will introduce the team to you and discuss the costs of our game’s production, our current follower count, and the progress of our development so far.

If you want to know more about SCHROTT and our team, check out the video!

[previewyoutube=XEt5ooXQJ6E;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be uploading more Devlogs in the future, so make sure to follow us on YouTube! If you are interested in any specific topic, write a comment, and we will cover it in one of the upcoming Devlogs.
